title: Sliding-window causal attention
summary: Replace dense causal visibility with a local causal window of 16 tokens and inspect the resulting attention shapes without running a campaign.

steps.explanation: Each query can attend only to causal keys inside the configured local window, rather than every earlier key.
observe: a shorter visible context when a prompt exceeds 16 tokens
No sparse-selection metric is emitted for sliding-window attention.

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer only for an initialized probe; prepare data before training.
try_changes: Predict which distant token becomes unavailable when the window is reduced.
Change only window_size and probe a prompt longer than the window.
Compare a brief train and held-out result without treating local context as a speed benchmark.
limits: This is a local causal masking implementation, not a sparse-kernel performance claim.
A smaller window can lose distant context; initialized probes do not measure task quality.
